blocks.text: Cold email at scale with unlimited sending accounts and smart delivery

Instantly focuses on the core challenge of cold email: getting your messages delivered and read at scale. Connect unlimited sending accounts, and Instantly rotates between them to maintain healthy sender reputation. The automated warm-up system gradually builds each account's credibility before you send.

The 450M+ B2B lead database means you can find prospects and launch campaigns without switching to a separate data provider. Filter by industry, company size, job title, technology used, and other criteria to build targeted lists that align with your ideal customer profile.

For teams doing high-volume outbound, Instantly's approach to email infrastructure management is its key differentiator. Most cold email tools focus on the sequence builder - Instantly focuses on making sure your emails actually reach the inbox.
Connect unlimited email accounts with automatic rotation
Automated email warm-up to build sender reputation
450M+ B2B contacts with filtering and list building
Distribute sends across accounts for optimal deliverability
Open rates, reply rates, and campaign performance tracking

Deliverability makes or breaks cold email campaigns. Instantly's focus on sender reputation management and inbox warming produces consistently better results than tools that treat infrastructure as an afterthought.
Our team can integrate Instantly into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
